snippet.title: Tilt. Reset. Repeat. Patience Balls - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the DEMO of Patience Balls on Steam right now! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4715000/Patience_Balls/

If you enjoy the physics-based chaos, adding the game to your Steam Wishlist helps me immensely as a solo indie developer!

---

About the Game:
Patience Balls is a minimalist physics puzzle game where one simple movement tilts multiple separate boards simultaneously. Can you find the perfect balance, dodge the hazards, and solve them all at once? Master the edge-less tension of Patience Mode, or unwind in the protective safety of Zen Mode.

Key Features:
• Precision Physics: Total control over the tilt of the board.
• No Safety Nets: Precision paths where one slip means an instant reset.
• Global Leaderboards: Compete against the world (and the developer) for Rank 1.
• Zen Mode: A relaxing alternative when you just want to watch the spheres roll.
